name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: build + test (blocking)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Build workspace
        run: cargo build --workspace --all-targets
      - name: Test workspace
        run: cargo test --workspace

  format:
    name: rustfmt (blocking)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

  clippy:
    name: clippy (blocking)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy
      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

  examples:
    name: repository examples parse (blocking)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Build CLI
        run: cargo build -p verseconf-cli
      - name: Parse every example
        run: |
          set -e
          for f in examples/*.vcf; do
            echo "== $f"
            ./target/debug/verseconf parse "$f"
          done
      - name: Formatting must be idempotent
        run: |
          set -e
          for f in examples/*.vcf; do
            ./target/debug/verseconf format "$f" -o /tmp/fmt1.vcf
            ./target/debug/verseconf format /tmp/fmt1.vcf -o /tmp/fmt2.vcf
            diff -u /tmp/fmt1.vcf /tmp/fmt2.vcf
          done
      - name: --fix must not touch a valid file
        run: |
          set -e
          cp examples/basic.vcf /tmp/clean.vcf
          ./target/debug/verseconf validate /tmp/clean.vcf --fix --write
          diff -u examples/basic.vcf /tmp/clean.vcf

  # 文档里的第一条安装命令必须真的成立：可执行文件叫 `verseconf`，
  # 核心库打出来的 tarball 必须能独立编译。
  distribution:
    name: CLI install + crate packaging (blocking)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Package the core crate and compile it from the tarball
        run: cargo package -p verseconf-core
      # 这里刻意**不**加 `cargo package -p verseconf-json`：打包验证会剥掉 path
      # 依赖、按 registry 上已发布的 verseconf-core 0.3.0 重新编译，而本仓库的
      # core 已经超过 0.3.0（EditRefusal 多了两个拒绝码），所以这一步在下一个
      # 版本发布之前必然失败。发布顺序见「把 JSON 适配 crate 纳入发布」：
      # 先发 core（含新拒绝码），再发 verseconf-json，最后才是 verseconf-mcp。
      - name: Install the CLI the way the docs say
        run: cargo install --path crates/verseconf-cli
      - name: Installed executable is named verseconf and runs
        run: |
          set -e
          verseconf --version
          verseconf parse examples/basic.vcf
          verseconf validate examples/basic.vcf

  # 文档诚实性：docs/SPECIFICATION.md 的每条状态标注都必须与实测一致。
  #
  # 这份规范曾经把"设计目标"和"已实现能力"混在一起叙述、全文没有状态标注，
  # 而 README 又声称"标注为未实现的条目请以本节为准"——指向了一份并不存在的标注。
  # 补上标注之后，真正防止它再次漂移的是这个作业：
  # 它按 docs/spec-status-probes.json 对每条声明真的跑一次 parse/validate，
  # 并交叉核对 §0.4 速查表把该写法列在 ✅ 还是 🚧 分区。
  # 无论"实现了标着未实现的特性"还是"改坏了标着已实现的特性"，这里都会失败。
  spec-status:
    name: spec status markers match reality (blocking)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Probe every SPEC status claim against the implementation
        run: cargo test -p verseconf-test --test spec_status

  # 公开基准：语料与判定固定，被测实现必须全对，且任何策略都不许出现不确定结果。
  fidelity-benchmark:
    name: edit fidelity benchmark (blocking)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Run the benchmark with the gate on
        run: cargo run -p verseconf-bench --release -- --check
      - name: Rerun must produce byte-identical results
        run: |
          set -e
          cp benchmark/results/latest.json /tmp/bench-first.json
          cargo run -q -p verseconf-bench --release > /dev/null
          diff -u /tmp/bench-first.json benchmark/results/latest.json

  # 不确定性报告的分析口径 + 预登记冻结物。
  #
  # 上一轮的 195 次运行不是 195 个独立样本：失败集中在唯一一份 CRLF 文件上。
  # 这个作业钉住两件事：区间必须按**来源**聚类算（同样的通过率，失败集中时
  # 区间必须显著更宽），以及预登记的任务集/生成器/加权分布没有被改过。
  # 「每条任务真的命中了它声称的特征」由 cargo test 里的 preregistration 测试管。
  analysis:
    name: cluster analysis + preregistration (blocking)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Cluster-bootstrap analysis tests
        run: node --test benchmark/analysis/cluster_report.test.mjs
      - name: Preregistration has not drifted
        run: node benchmark/confirmation/preregistration.mjs --verify

  # 门禁增量实验的冻结物（TF-0099 / TF-0100）。
  #
  # 这一轮问的是「门禁在真实使用中有没有增量」，所以样本必须是真的：
  # 8 份真实上游文档 + 只写意图的指令。这个作业钉住两件事：
  # 冻结物没被手改（任务集/判定口径/引用文档的指纹），
  # 以及每条任务真的测到了它声称的东西（blocking 真的被拒、advisory 与安全写法真的放行）。
  # 开跑之后改冻结物 = 换了一套样本，必须作废本轮数据——所以这里直接失败。
  gate-increment:
    name: gate-increment corpus + preregistration (blocking)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Preregistration has not drifted
        run: node benchmark/gate-increment/verify.mjs --verify
      - name: Round 2 preregistration has not drifted
        run: node benchmark/gate-increment/verify.mjs --verify --dir benchmark/gate-increment-round2
      - name: Round 3 preregistration has not drifted
        run: node benchmark/gate-increment/verify.mjs --verify --dir benchmark/gate-increment-round3
      - name: Round 4 preregistration has not drifted
        run: node benchmark/gate-increment/verify.mjs --verify --dir benchmark/gate-increment-round4
      - name: Round 5 preregistration has not drifted
        run: node benchmark/gate-increment/verify.mjs --verify --dir benchmark/gate-increment-round5
      - name: Every task really exercises the gate
        run: cargo test -p verseconf-toml --test gate_increment
      - name: Deterministic refusal classifier self-check
        run: node --test benchmark/gate-increment/classify.test.mjs

  # 性能数字必须来自真实运行。
  #
  # 此前 README 的「比 TOML 快 2.8-4.1 倍」来自 generate_charts.py 里手写的
  # dict，而基准的数据路径是 CWD 相对的（从 compare/ 里执行会去找
  # compare/compare/test_data/），读不到数据时输出全 0 并仍然 exit 0。这个作业
  # 把「数字必须来自真实运行」和「缺数据必须失败」两条都钉住。
  performance-benchmark:
    name: performance benchmark (blocking)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Generate the comparison datasets
        run: cargo run -q -p verseconf-compare --bin generate_test_data
      - name: Run the benchmark and write machine-readable results
        run: cargo run -q --release -p verseconf-compare --bin benchmark -- --json compare/benchmark_results.json
      - name: Chart report must regenerate from that file
        run: python3 compare/generate_charts.py
      - name: Missing data must fail loudly, not report zeros
        run: |
          set -e
          mv compare/test_data compare/test_data.bak
          if cargo run -q --release -p verseconf-compare --bin benchmark -- --json /tmp/nope.json; then
            echo "::error::benchmark succeeded with no data — silent-zero regression" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          mv compare/test_data.bak compare/test_data
      - name: Chart script must refuse to invent numbers
        run: |
          set -e
          if python3 compare/generate_charts.py /tmp/definitely-missing.json; then
            echo "::error::generate_charts.py succeeded without benchmark results" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

  # 宿主零安装分发：wasm 产物必须在真实消费者环境里可加载，并且与命令行结果一致。
  wasm-distribution:
    name: wasm distribution (blocking)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Install wasm-pack
        run: |
          curl https://rustwasm.github.io/wasm-pack/installer/init.sh -sSf | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Build npm package (wasm + tsc)
        working-directory: integrations/verseconf-wasm/js-api
        run: |
          npm install --no-audit --no-fund
          npm run build
      - name: Load smoke tests (CJS / ESM / nodejs / web / stdio server)
        working-directory: integrations/verseconf-wasm/js-api
        run: node test/load.test.mjs
      - name: Package and clean-install tests
        working-directory: integrations/verseconf-wasm/js-api
        run: node test/package.test.mjs
      - name: Build native binaries for the parity check
        run: cargo build -p verseconf-cli -p verseconf-mcp
      - name: wasm vs CLI / native binary parity
        working-directory: integrations/verseconf-wasm/js-api
        run: node test/parity.mjs
